  RECOMMENDATIONS:
    - "Priority 1 — Adjustable Dumbbells (or adjustable kettlebell set): 5..40 kg per hand total capacity (or two adjustable dumbbells 2.5..20 kg each). They save space and allow progressive overload for upper and lower body exercises."
    - "Priority 2 — Adjustable Barbell with Plates (if space): standard or Olympic set with 60..100 kg total capacity. Best for long-term progression on squat and deadlift variations."
    - "Priority 3 — Pull-up Bar (already owned): keep and consider adding gymnastic rings for rows/dips progression."
    - "Priority 4 — Resistance Bands (loop and long): light..heavy. Useful for assisted pull-ups, banded squats, variable resistance, and mobility work."

  RECOMMENDATIONS:
    - "Priority 1 — Adjustable Dumbbells (or adjustable kettlebell set): 5..40 kg per hand total capacity (or two adjustable dumbbells 2.5..20 kg each). They save space and allow progressive overload for upper and lower body exercises."

NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Calories: estimate maintenance using online calculator; for muscle gain add +250-400 kcal per day. For minimal fat gain prefer +250 kcal."
    - "Protein: target 1.6..2.2 g/kg bodyweight per day. Prefer ~2.0 g/kg for beginners focused on strength."
    - "Carbohydrates: 3..6 g/kg per day depending on training volume (higher on heavy days)."
    - "Fats: 20..30% of total calories; keep at least 0.8..1.0 g/kg."
    - "Meal timing: 3 main meals + 1-2 snacks. Include a protein-containing meal/snack within 1-2 hours after training."
    - "Hydration: aim for 2.5..3 L water per day; more on hot days or heavy sweat."
    - "Protein sources: eggs, dairy, lean meat, fish, legumes, tofu. If needed, use whey or plant protein powder to hit targets."
    - "Progression: weigh weekly; if no strength/weight increase after 2-3 weeks, increase daily calories by ~150-250 kcal."
  SAMPLE_DAY "Maintenance + 250 kcal surplus":
    - "Breakfast: 3 eggs, 1 serving oats, 1 piece fruit. (~25-30 g protein)"
    - "Lunch: protein source (150-200 g cooked), rice or potato, vegetables. (~40-60 g protein)"
    - "Snack: yogurt or protein shake + banana. (~20-30 g protein)"
    - "Dinner: protein source (150-200 g cooked), mixed vegetables, healthy fat (olive oil/avocado). (~40-60 g protein)"
    - "Evening: cottage cheese or casein source if needed. (~10-20 g protein)"
  WEEKLY_SCHEDULE:
    - "Training days: slightly higher carbs (add 1 serving of rice/pasta/fruit)."
    - "Non-training days: reduce carbs slightly, keep protein consistent."
    - "Weigh-in: same time each week (fasted or after voiding) to track trend."
  SUPPLEMENTS:
    - "Creatine monohydrate: 3..5 g daily (optional, effective for strength gains)."
    - "Vitamin D: if low or limited sun exposure, consider supplement after blood test."
    - "Protein powder: optional to reach daily protein targets."
  SAFETY:
    - "If any medical conditions, allergies, or dietary restrictions exist, consult a healthcare professional before following the plan."

EQUIPMENT_GUIDE
  RECOMMENDATIONS:
    - "Priority 1 — Adjustable Dumbbells (or adjustable kettlebell set): 5..40 kg per hand total capacity (or two adjustable dumbbells 2.5..20 kg each). They save space and allow progressive overload for upper and lower body exercises."
    - "Priority 2 — Adjustable Barbell with Plates (if space): standard or Olympic set with 60..100 kg total capacity. Best for long-term progression on squat and deadlift variations."
    - "Priority 3 — Pull-up Bar (already owned): keep and consider adding gymnastic rings for rows/dips progression."
    - "Priority 4 — Resistance Bands (loop and long): light..heavy. Useful for assisted pull-ups, face_pull, banded squats, and mobility work."
    - "Priority 5 — Flat/Adjustable Bench or sturdy coffee table alternative: helpful for split support, incline/decline pressing and step-ups."
    - "Priority 6 — Heavy Kettlebell (12..24 kg) or single heavier dumbbell: useful for swings, goblet squats, and farmer carries when space limits buying full sets."
  BUYING_GUIDANCE:
    - "Start small and scalable: if budget/space limited, begin with adjustable dumbbells + bands + bench substitute. This covers most progressions."
    - "Choose metal plates or certified adjustable systems over low-quality plastic for longevity."
    - "When selecting weights, ensure you can load enough for lower-body lifts: aim to reach at least double-bodyweight squat capacity over time; plan equipment that allows progressive increases (hence 60..100 kg barbell capacity)."
  PROGRESSION_USE:
    - "Dumbbells: use for goblet squats, split squats, dumbbell press, rows, farmer carries, single-leg Romanian deadlift progressions."
    - "Barbell: use for squat, Romanian_deadlift, deadlift, bent_over_row if available and comfortable in flat."
    - "Bands: for pull-up assistance, face_pull, banded squats, and warm-up activation."
    - "Kettlebell: for swings (hip power), goblet squats, and loaded carries when space/time limited."
  SAFETY_NOTES:
    - "Prioritise good technique before adding heavy weight. Progress load when you can perform top of the rep range for all sets with solid form."
    - "Ensure floor and ceiling clearances are sufficient for bar/dumbbell use and overhead movements."
    - "Consider neighbors in an apartment: use mats for noise reduction and avoid dropping weights."
  SAMPLE_MINIMAL_PURCHASE_PATH:
    - "Phase 1 (0..3 months): resistance bands + adjustable dumbbells to 20 kg per hand + small bench substitute."
    - "Phase 2 (3..12 months): upgrade adjustable dumbbells to 30..40 kg per hand or add barbell + plates to reach 60..100 kg total."
    - "Long-term: full barbell set and storage if pursuing heavier strength goals."
